title: Stale line-number reference in loop-guard comment
description: uuencoding/src/decode.rs:124-125: comment says 'post-loop truncation (line ~249)' but after the 110-line deletion the truncation code is now at line 152. The stale reference misleads a reader tracing the code path. Fix: remove the '(line ~249)' reference or update to 'below'.
